childNodes.textContent: Your process — Blocks proof of concept

Blocks proof of concept — a business process becomes four steps, one
  smart block on each, set up a little, then run. For you, or for a
  client in their brand.

  Skinned as the marketing site in the new brand (sell-to-many remix 24:
  ?theme=brand&layout=mvp2, brand book v5). The page, the builder frame and the client's
  app all use that site's own stylesheets and brand lookup, linked from
  sell-to-many/ rather than copied, so it looks like the same product.

  Three ways in: ?t=edm, ?t=screening, ?combo=1. See README.md here.
  With a model: python3 live.py --blocks

attributes.data-label: Blocks proof of concept — four steps, one block each

childNodes.textContent: Let’s build it from how the job gets done today. I’ll turn it into four steps, one smart block on each.
The Qantas assistant, in Qantas’ voice
Now tell me how the job gets done today at Qantas: the steps, who does them, the tools. A messy list is fine, or attach the procedure.

When we hire, the hiring manager writes up the role and what a good candidate looks like. Recruiters collect CVs from the inbox and job boards, read each one and score it in a spreadsheet, then the hiring manager picks who goes to interview.
As I read it, in the order it happens, with the tool each step lives in.
Hiring manager defines ideal candidate profile
Recruiters collect CVs from job boards
Hiring manager selects candidates for interview
The hiring manager defines the role and candidate criteria. Recruiters gather and score CVs, then the hiring manager selects candidates for interviews.
Select candidates for interview based on scored CVs.
Hiring manager starts by defining role; recruiters collect and score CVs; hiring manager chooses interviewees.
A shortlist of candidates selected for interviews.
This looks like the Candidate screening template
Describe the role, add the CVs, get a scored table, agree a shortlist. Its four steps: Role → CVs → Screen → Shortlist.
Jev picked from the 20 templates we have, and how sure it is (confidence 100%).
, in Qantas’ brand. Now set up each block. Everything you change shows on the right as you go, and you can ask me for changes below.
Describe the role and what a strong candidate looks like.
Each time it runs, the person running it fills these in. Add, rename or remove fields, or ask the builder below.
